description: §15.10.1 (S459 H1/M1) — ONE component scope, read side: markup BEFORE the declaration reads the prop (`n` -> @v = 7); markup AFTER `${ let n = 3; const label = "S" }` — text interpolation, a quoted attribute value, a nested element, a later `lift` — reads the LOCALS (3, S), not the props (`bind:n=@v`, `label="L"`). The parent cell `@v` is unchanged. Before S459 later markup read the props (L and 7) while the block's own functions read the locals.
rationale: §15.10.1: "From the point of declaration onward in the same scope, the local binding shadows the prop." The Greeter worked example reads a component logic block's `const greeting` in the markup after it — the same scope.
